library(dplyr)

set.seed(1031)

## Synthetic embedding distances

```{r data}
draw_mixture <- function(n, means, sds, weights) {
  component <- sample(seq_along(means), n, replace = TRUE, prob = weights)
  values <- rnorm(n, means[component], sds[component])
  pmin(1.50, pmax(0.20, values))
}

level_specs <- tribble(
  ~tree_distance, ~sample_size,
  1, 1050,
  2, 4210,
  3, 8120,
  4, 10840,
  5, 11520
)

embedding_data <- bind_rows(
  tibble(tree_distance = 1, embedding_distance = draw_mixture(
    1050, c(0.73, 0.96, 1.23), c(0.10, 0.08, 0.09), c(0.35, 0.45, 0.20)
  )),
  tibble(tree_distance = 2, embedding_distance = draw_mixture(
    4210, c(0.55, 0.82, 1.02), c(0.08, 0.15, 0.13), c(0.12, 0.33, 0.55)
  )),
  tibble(tree_distance = 3, embedding_distance = draw_mixture(
    8120, c(0.72, 1.04, 1.18), c(0.12, 0.13, 0.09), c(0.14, 0.66, 0.20)
  )),
  tibble(tree_distance = 4, embedding_distance = draw_mixture(
    10840, c(0.83, 1.12, 1.27), c(0.15, 0.11, 0.09), c(0.19, 0.62, 0.19)
  )),
  tibble(tree_distance = 5, embedding_distance = draw_mixture(
    11520, c(0.92, 1.17, 1.33), c(0.12, 0.09, 0.07), c(0.20, 0.64, 0.16)
  ))
)

density_data <- bind_rows(lapply(split(embedding_data, embedding_data$tree_distance), function(group) {
  density_result <- density(
    group$embedding_distance,
    from = 0.20,
    to = 1.50,
    n = 512,
    adjust = 0.90
  )

  level <- unique(group$tree_distance)
  tibble(
    tree_distance = level,
    embedding_distance = density_result$x,
    density = density_result$y,
    ridge_y = level + 0.78 * density_result$y / max(density_result$y)
  )
}))

write.csv(embedding_data, "synthetic_embedding_distances.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(density_data, "density_curves.csv", row.names = FALSE)

level_specs
```

brackets <- tibble(
  comparison = paste0(seq_len(4), "_", seq_len(4) + 1),
  y0 = 1:4 + 0.42,
  y1 = 2:5 + 0.42,
  x = 1.58
)

axis_ticks <- tibble(

sample_labels <- level_specs %>%
  mutate(
    x = 0.255,
    y = tree_distance + 0.63,
    label = paste0("(n = ", format(sample_size, big.mark = ","), ")")

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = density_data,
